verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֬חַ׀ לִבְנֵי־ קֹ֬רַח מִזְמֽוֹר׃ רָצִ֣יתָ יְהוָ֣ה אַרְצֶ֑ךָ שַׁ֝֗בְתָּ שְׁבוּת יַעֲקֹֽב׃
verses.transliteration: lam·naṣ·ṣê·aḥ liḇ·nê- qō·raḥ miz·mō·wr rā·ṣî·ṯā Yah·weh ’ar·ṣe·ḵā šab̲·tā šə·ḇūṯ ya·‘ă·qōḇ
verses.literal: For the choirmaster A Psalm of the sons of Korah You showed favor to Your land O LORD You restored Jacob from captivity

verses.original: נָ֭שָׂאתָ עֲוֺ֣ן עַמֶּ֑ךָ כִּסִּ֖יתָ כָל־ חַטָּאתָ֣ם סֶֽלָה׃
verses.literal: You forgave the iniquity of Your people You covered all their sin Selah

verses.original: אָסַ֥פְתָּ כָל־ עֶבְרָתֶ֑ךָ הֱ֝שִׁיב֗וֹתָ מֵחֲר֥וֹן אַפֶּֽךָ׃
verses.literal: You withheld all Your fury You turned from Your burning anger . . .

verses.original: שׁ֭וּבֵנוּ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׁעֵ֑נוּ וְהָפֵ֖ר כַּֽעַסְךָ֣ עִמָּֽנוּ׃
verses.literal: Restore us O God of our salvation and put away Your displeasure toward us

verses.original: הַלְעוֹלָ֥ם תֶּֽאֱנַף־ בָּ֑נוּ תִּמְשֹׁ֥ךְ אַ֝פְּךָ֗ לְדֹ֣ר וָדֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: hal·‘ō·w·lām te·’ĕ·nap̄- bā·nū tim·šōḵ ’ap·pə·ḵā lə·ḏōr wā·ḏōr
verses.literal: Will You be angry with us forever Will You draw out Your anger to all generations

verses.original: הֲֽלֹא־ אַ֭תָּה תָּשׁ֣וּב תְּחַיֵּ֑נוּ וְ֝עַמְּךָ֗ יִשְׂמְחוּ־ בָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: hă·lō- ’at·tāh tā·šūḇ tə·ḥay·yê·nū wə·‘am·mə·ḵā yiś·mə·ḥū- ḇāḵ
verses.literal: Will You not revive us again that Your people may rejoice in You

verses.original: הַרְאֵ֣נוּ יְהוָ֣ה חַסְדֶּ֑ךָ וְ֝יֶשְׁעֲךָ֗ תִּתֶּן־ לָֽנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: har·’ê·nū Yah·weh ḥas·de·ḵā wə·yeš·‘ă·ḵā tit·ten- lā·nū
verses.literal: Show us Your loving devotion O LORD and grant us Your salvation

verses.original: אֶשְׁמְעָ֗ה מַה־ יְדַבֵּר֮ הָאֵ֪ל׀ יְה֫וָ֥ה כִּ֤י׀ יְדַבֵּ֬ר שָׁל֗וֹם אֶל־ עַמּ֥וֹ וְאֶל־ חֲסִידָ֑יו וְֽאַל־ יָשׁ֥וּבוּ לְכִסְלָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’eš·mə·‘āh mah- yə·ḏab·bêr hā·’êl Yah·weh kî yə·ḏab·bêr šā·lō·wm ’el- ‘am·mōw wə·’el- ḥă·sî·ḏāw wə·’al- yā·šū·ḇū lə·ḵis·lāh
verses.literal: I will listen to what God the LORD will say for He will surely speak peace to His people and His saints He will not let them return to folly

verses.original: אַ֤ךְ׀ קָר֣וֹב לִירֵאָ֣יו יִשְׁע֑וֹ לִשְׁכֹּ֖ן כָּב֣וֹד בְּאַרְצֵֽנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’aḵ qā·rō·wḇ lî·rê·’āw yiš·‘ōw liš·kōn kā·ḇō·wḏ bə·’ar·ṣê·nū
verses.literal: Surely His salvation is near to those who fear Him that His glory may dwell in our land

verses.original: חֶֽסֶד־ וֶאֱמֶ֥ת נִפְגָּ֑שׁוּ צֶ֖דֶק וְשָׁל֣וֹם נָשָֽׁקוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ḥe·seḏ- we·’ĕ·meṯ nip̄·gā·šū ṣe·ḏeq wə·šā·lō·wm nā·šā·qū
verses.literal: Loving devotion and faithfulness have joined together righteousness and peace have kissed

verses.original: אֱ֭מֶת מֵאֶ֣רֶץ תִּצְמָ֑ח וְ֝צֶ֗דֶק מִשָּׁמַ֥יִם נִשְׁקָֽף׃
verses.literal: Faithfulness sprouts from the earth and righteousness looks down from heaven

verses.original: גַּם־ יְ֭הוָה יִתֵּ֣ן הַטּ֑וֹב וְ֝אַרְצֵ֗נוּ תִּתֵּ֥ן יְבוּלָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: gam- Yah·weh yit·tên haṭ·ṭō·wḇ wə·’ar·ṣê·nū tit·tên yə·ḇū·lāh
verses.literal: The LORD will indeed provide what is good . . . and our land will yield its increase

verses.original: צֶ֭דֶק לְפָנָ֣יו יְהַלֵּ֑ךְ וְיָשֵׂ֖ם לְדֶ֣רֶךְ פְּעָמָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: ṣe·ḏeq lə·p̄ā·nāw yə·hal·lêḵ wə·yā·śêm lə·ḏe·reḵ pə·‘ā·māw
verses.literal: Righteousness will go before Him to prepare the way for His steps
